about: Shared INV-I corpus (CLAUDE.md §5 INV-I, §9 rule 2; WRD-16 §10.1, §10.5; design A06 §5.1 step 6, §11.3).
Every layer that enforces the platform deny-list runs this one file, so the layers cannot drift apart:
the matcher itself and the mount layer (internal/sandbox TestDenyListThreeLayers, M2-12),
the executor layer (internal/exec, M2-6) and the policy layer (internal/policy, M3).
worktree_refused: worktree-relative paths every layer must refuse (mount layer: masked).
worktree_allowed: worktree-relative controls no layer may refuse, so over-blocking is caught too.
host_refused: absolute host paths outside the task roots that must never be reachable from a sandbox.
No worktree path is a prefix of another and no two differ only in case, so a test can materialise
the worktree lists as a real tree on a case-insensitive file system. Add paths; never remove one.
